title: Create a lambda function
description: Create a lambda that performs an operation of your choice. Call it and print the result.
solution:

title: Filter values with lambda
description: Create a list and use filter() with a lambda to keep values that match a condition you choose. Print the result.
solution:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
evens = list(filter(lambda n: n % 2 == 0, numbers))
print(evens)

title: Transform values with lambda
description: Create a list and use map() with a lambda to transform each value. Print the result.
